propositions: The undecomposed hard-override axis fires on only 0.107% of plan-v3 verified findings (11/10,250) and 0.153% of plan-v4 (18/11,773), two orders of magnitude below other severity axes, yet unconditionally floors impact to 0.85 regardless of grade.

The stated justification—that a G5 deterministic suppressor prevents false flat-plan findings because most tickets have children—is factually contradicted: the suppressor never fired (g5_undecomposed_vetoed is absent from all 2,000 sidecars) and over 90% of reviewed tickets are childless.

The axis's low grade fires (16/29 across both versions) produce blocks solely via the 0.85 floor when no other hard-override criterion is present (25/29 fires), making low-grade undecomposed fires equivalent to high-grade for impact purposes—a miscalibration matching earlier problems in ac_unverifiable and divergent_implementation.

An inverse-population match against the axis's own suppressor regex finds 33 plan-v3 and 17 plan-v4 findings with matching text but undecomposed=none grades, but these are regex false positives (code decomposition, module seams) rather than missed flat-plan defects.

The axis is neither correctly suppressed (suppressor inert) nor unreachable (fires are genuine and stable), but mis-calibrated: it is the last ordinal-ladder hard-override axis still flooring on its weakest grade, requiring gate-grading per ADR 0054.
